vb_textbox.text: My advice is to trust your judgement. The gnomes are presented in pairs - one yields a better outcome more often and then sometimes it switches. For instance the purple and red gnome are presented together. The purple gnome yields a higher number of mushrooms than the red one. However, after some rounds it switches to the red one and vice versa throughout. Sometimes the pattern isnt consistent though and tries to make you think the pattern has changed but it hasn't. Generally, I was finding purple, blue and pink yielded the higher mushroom amounts but this wasnt always the case. Try to identify the better of the pair and stick with that colour for a while. If you get 2 or 3 low yields in a row with a particular colour switch to the other one. Because of the time you get to think, dont worry about picking the wrong one - go with your instinct. Have fun with the game. Best of luck!
